## App or site change

Describe what this adds or fixes.

- [ ] Local app files are under `apps/tedt/<slug>/`.
- [ ] The complete folder includes supporting files, preview, README, and MIT license.
- [ ] No credentials or personal configuration are included.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] State whether the app was tested on hardware, the emulator, or neither.
